meta.source: Owner's sketch (2026-11-06): cupboard C2 in the foyer with a seat (to put on shoes) and a surface (keys etc.).
meta.foyer: Foyer x 1750 (shelter wall face) - 4100 (kitchen west wall face), y 4720 - 7580 (entrance wall face). Main door x 2425-3425, opens inwards, hinge on the shelter side.

c2.note: Full height, 400 deep, along the kitchen's west wall (1670 long, wall end to entrance wall). Front at x 3700 -> 1950 clear foyer; ~275 past the main door's frame. Seen from the foyer: shoe cabinet + key surface on the left (north), shoe-on seat on the right (south, by the door), top cabinets to the ceiling across both.

surface.note: Oak key / wallet / mail surface at 1030 high, 60 proud of the doors.

niche.note: Open niche with oak back, LED strip and key hooks.

seat.note: Seat 480 high (with cushion), 480 deep; for putting on shoes.

alcove.note: Open alcove above the seat: oak back, coat / bag hooks, LED.
